doc.brief: The QSplashScreen widget provides a splash screen that can be shown during application startup.
doc.index_brief: Splash screen that can be shown during application startup

QSplashScreen(QScreen *screen, const QPi.brief: This function allows you to specify the screen for your splashscreen.

QSplashScreen(const QPixmap &pixmap, Qt:.brief: Construct a splash screen that will display the *pixmap*.

QString message() const.brief: Returns the message that is currently displayed on the splash screen.

const QPixmap pixmap() const.brief: Returns the pixmap that is used in the splash screen.

void clearMessage().brief: Removes the message being displayed on the splash screen

void drawContents(QPainter *painter).brief: Draw the contents of the splash screen using painter *painter*.

void finish(QWidget *mainWin).brief: Makes the splash screen wait until the widget *mainWin* is displayed before calling [close](xref:qt:QWidget)() on itself.

void messageChanged(const QString &messa.brief: This signal is emitted when the message on the splash screen changes. *message* is the new message and is a null-string when the message has been removed.

void setPixmap(const QPixmap &pixmap).brief: Sets the pixmap that will be used as the splash screen's image to *pixmap*.

void showMessage(const QString &message,.brief: Draws the *message* text onto the splash screen with color *color* and aligns the text according to the flags in *alignment*.
